question: Bimbavati Devi is an exponent of which Indian dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Manipuri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Manipuri dancers and exponents** Guru Bipin Singh and Guru Kalavati Devi **are the parents of **Bimbavati Devi.**
 
• At a very young age, she was introduced to the **world of dance and music.**
 
• She has received instruction in **pung (Manipuri mridang)** playing and the **fundamentals of Thang Ta** in addition to **dancing (Manipuri martial art).**
 
• She was a performing and **solo performer of Manipuri Nartanalaya.**

 [IMAGE: https://images.jdmagicbox.com/events/A420901/A420901_list_20160330132326.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chhau:**

 
 
• **Eastern Indian**s have a practice known as Chhau dance.
 
• It recreates scenes from **epics like the Mahabharata and the Ramayana** as well as** regional folklore and abstract ideas.**
 
• The Chhau dance in the region of J**harkhand, West Bengal and Odisha.**
 
 
 
• **Kathakali:**
 
 
• **​**A significant type of **classical Indian dance is Kathakali.**
 
• It belongs to the **"story play" art form.**
 
• Kathakali comes from southwestern India, around the state of **Kerala**.
 
 
 
• **Odissi:**
 
 
• ​The important ancient dance known as **Odissi **was created in the** temples of Odisha.**
